name: Predetermination
overview: Scripture reveals that God, in His sovereign will, predestines believers to be conformed to the image of His Son and adopts them as His children, according to His good pleasure and purpose. This divine predetermination ensures that those whom God foreknew are drawn to Christ by the Father and granted eternal life through faith in Jesus. The believer's inheritance and salvation are secured by God's unchanging counsel and grace, emphasizing His authority over all things and the assurance of redemption for those called by Him.
